messages:
Rhea (Docs): Hey all 1 opened PR to update the Orpheus6b model card + catalog row. Changes: explicit supported-memory tiers, clarify streaming long-context (up to 24k with KV cache), correct quant-profile names, and replace an out-of-date SDK example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5033 please quick read for anything customer-facing.

Owen (Runtime): Quick heads-up: use runtime labels in the compatibility table (orpheus6b-q4_1, orpheus6b-q8_0, orpheus6b-fp16). Also mention our automatic fp16 fallback on hosts lacking q4 kernels.

Priya (Bench): Pasted bench runs in the PR comment: orpheus6b-q4_1 on A10: 195-240 tok/s (batch=1, seq=2048), on T4: 68-95 tok/s (batch=1, seq=2048). Variance due to cold starts and prompt shape. I'll attach the harness and exact docker tag.

Marcus (DevEx): Updated python + TS snippets to streaming API and added a small retry/fallback example. Python sample in the PR:
```python
from redwood import Client, FallbackDetected
client = Client()
try:
  for chunk in client.generate_stream('Summarize this report', model='orpheus6b-q4_1'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
except FallbackDetected:
  # try fp16 variant explicitly
  for chunk in client.generate_stream('Summarize this report', model='orpheus6b-fp16'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Can runtime confirm the exception name?

Owen (Runtime): The SDK error type is RuntimeFallbackError (not FallbackDetected). Also the stream emits a metadata event {"runtime_fallback":true, "variant":"orpheus6b-fp16"} before the first fallback chunk. Please update the snippet to reflect that.

Rhea (Docs): thanks, updated snippet and added a small note about the metadata event. Also added a short canary rollback blurb for Dedicated customers: how to pin to orpheus6b-fp16 and when to roll back. Lina, can you review the customer-facing phrasing?

Lina (PM): LGTM on the content. Two nits: 1) don't use words like "ultra" or "best". 2) in the throughput callout, present ranges and include the test config inline. Maybe: "expected throughput: ~70-95 tok/s on T4 and ~195-240 tok/s on A10 (batch=1, seq=2048); measured with canonical benchmark prompts."

Priya (Bench): +1 to Lina's wording. Also add a short note that batching improves amortized throughput but increases p95 for single-request latency; link to batching guidance.

docbot: docs-ci/pr-check failed  markdown-lint: duplicate-anchor-id in supported-variants table. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/1325

Rhea (Docs): fixing anchors and switching the internal runtime link to the public compat page. Re-requesting review after push.

docbot: docs-ci/pr-check passed on second run :white_check_mark:

Marcus (DevEx): Pushed the JS parity example and added a short note about how to detect the runtime_fallback metadata on the client stream.

Owen (Runtime): LGTM. One small detail: recommend including the exact runtime label examples in the model-catalog so customers can paste them into configs.

Rhea (Docs): Will add the explicit runtime label examples and merge in ~10m unless anyone objects. I'll post a short summary in #docs-release highlighting the catalog change, fallback behavior, and bench caveats. Thanks!
